Instruction: Generate code that performs a multiphysics analysis using the PyAEDT library. The code should import the necessary libraries and set the graphical mode. It should then download and open a project, and start HFSS with a specified version. The code should also start a Circuit and add the HFSS dynamic link component to it. It should set up dynamic link options and create ports and excitations. The code should then create a setup and solve the circuit, pushing excitations to the HFSS model. It should start Mechanical and copy bodies from the HFSS project. The code should get losses from HFSS and assign the convection to Mechanical. Finally, the code should plot the model, solve and plot the thermal results, and release AEDT.

You can find the following APIs from the library helpful:
get_version_and_release, test_54b_open_and_load_a_polyline, move_and_connect_to, duplicate_and_unite, duplicate_and_mirror, set_position_and_rotation, check_and_download_file, check_and_download_folder, GetHashCode, get_position_and_rotation, clean_cache_and_files, enforce_dc_and_causality, array_center_and_edge, _update_segments_and_points, get_pinlist_from_component_and_net, _get_reference_and_integration_points, test_05_center_and_centroid, test_06_duplicate_and_mirror, _read_and_synch_settings_file, check_and_fix_via_plating

```python
import os
from pyaedt import Desktop, downloads, Hfss, Circuit, Mechanical

# Set graphical mode
desktop_version = "2023.2"
non_graphical = False

# Launch AEDT in graphical mode
d = Desktop(desktop_version, non_graphical=non_graphical, new_desktop_session=True)

# Download and open a sample project
project_path = downloads.download_file("hfss", "coaxial_cable.aedt", destination_folder=os.getcwd())
project_name = os.path.basename(project_path)
d.open_project(project_path)

# Start HFSS with specified version
hfss = Hfss(projectname=project_name, specified_version=desktop_version)

# Start Circuit and add HFSS dynamic link component
circuit = Circuit(projectname=project_name, specified_version=desktop_version)
hfss_dynamic_link = circuit.modeler.schematic.add_dynamic_link(hfss, solution_name="Setup1 : LastAdaptive")

# Set up dynamic link options
hfss_dynamic_link.set_dynamic_link_options(
    sweep_type="Discrete",
    interpolation="Linear",
    use_interpolating_sweep=False
)

# Create ports and excitations in Circuit
port1 = circuit.modeler.schematic.create_port("Port1")
port2 = circuit.modeler.schematic.create_port("Port2")
circuit.modeler.schematic.connect_components(port1, hfss_dynamic_link.pins[0])
circuit.modeler.schematic.connect_components(port2, hfss_dynamic_link.pins[1])

# Create a setup and solve the circuit, push excitations to HFSS
setup_circuit = circuit.create_setup("CircuitSetup1")
setup_circuit.props["Frequency"] = "1GHz"
setup_circuit.update()
circuit.analyze_setup("CircuitSetup1")
hfss.push_excitation_to_hfss()

# Start Mechanical and copy bodies from HFSS
mechanical = Mechanical(projectname=project_name, specified_version=desktop_version)
mechanical.copy_bodies_from(hfss)

# Get losses from HFSS and assign convection to Mechanical
losses = hfss.get_loss("Setup1", "LastAdaptive")
mechanical.assign_convection_to_faces(
    faces=mechanical.modeler.get_faces(),
    convection_value=10,
    ambient_temperature=22
)
mechanical.assign_losses(losses)

# Plot the model
mechanical.plot(show=True)

# Solve and plot the thermal results
mechanical.analyze_setup("Setup1")
mechanical.plot_thermal_results(quantity="Temperature", show=True)

# Release AEDT
d.release_desktop(close_projects=True, close_desktop=True)
```
